pages.text: Pale veins take hold in stone. The air loses its color. Somewhere nearby, something beats.
pages.title: The Bloom
A fire under bark
pages.text: A colony grows from an assimilation heart. Its veins spread along sturdy faces; the heart keeps them alive. Fresh growth slowly drains color from its host, leaving the land ashen. Ember knots pulse with the colony while its heart

pages.title: A fire under bark
pages.text: lives. Breaking that heart arrests its colony.

pages.title: A fire under bark
pages.text: Watch the ember flecks. They are a warning before the land becomes unfamiliar.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: Take essence from attached growth before destroying the heart if you need a sample. Growth lost with its support yields no harvest.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: Exposure near a live heart can infect you. Leave its reach to let low exposure subside; do not work beside it indefinitely.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: This is not proof the Bloom was born here. Only proof it has learned to live here.
